This is a French reading lesson on a blackboard with two sections. I'm not sure of some words; those are marked "?" or "...".

Left section (letters, then example words):
m – Mika
r – un chat
l – papa
? – maman

Right section:
Jeudi 13 septembre
... une amie
samedi
il y a

Syllables, mostly circled, on the right of the board:
ma   li
na   si
pa   la
ri   si
(mi) – circled, at the bottom
summary: The blackboard was straight ahead, so I began reading at its centre. I swept left to the column of letters and example words, then right to the date and the circled syllables, and finished at the bottom. I stopped after eight fixations, with a few words still uncertain.
